request.initial_prompt: "Estella, dearest Estella, do not let Miss Havisham lead you into this fatal step. Put me aside for ever,—you have done so, I well know,—but bestow yourself on some worthier person than Drummle. Miss Havisham gives you to him, as the greatest slight and injury that could be done to the many far better men who admire you, and to the few who truly love you. Among those few there may be one who loves you even as dearly, though he has not loved you as long, as I. Take him, and I can bear it better, for your sake!"
request.hotwords: Estella, Miss, Havisham, Put, I, Drummle, Among, Take

raw_segments.text: Estella, dearest Estella, do not let Miss Havisham lead you into this fatal step. Put me aside
for ever,—you have done so, I well know,—but bestow yourself on some worthier person than
Drummle. Miss Havisham gives you to him, as the greatest slight and injury that could
be done to the many far better men who admire you, and to the few who truly love you. Among
those few there may be one who loves you even as dearly, though he has not loved you as
long, as I. Take him, and I can bear it better, for your sake!
